entry.name: framedelta~
entry.digest: Compute phase deviation between successive FFT frames
entry.description: framedelta~ computes a running phase deviation by subtracting values in each position of its previously received signal vector from the current signal vector. When used inside a pfft~ object, it keeps a running phase deviation of the FFT because the FFT size is equal to the signal vector size.
